correctness.rationale: Conditioning on an excedance at position i makes the selected value uniform on {i+1,...,n}; the deterministic permutation sum then fixes the common conditional shift of all other positions. This yields the arbitrary-weight covariance formula directly. Squared displacement is affine in the weighted rank inner product, and exact indicator-pair counts and centered-rank moments independently give the excedance and Spearman variances. Exhaustive checks through n=9 and exact closed-form replay through n=1000 match every displayed identity.

value.rationale: Excedance count is a canonical Eulerian statistic and Spearman rho is a canonical global rank-displacement summary. The arbitrary-weight local law is structurally reusable rather than a one-off moment, and its Spearman specialization reveals a nontrivial sign reversal across positions. The total-count corollary gives a simple exact finite redundancy scale, while the local theorem explains where that aggregate dependence comes from.
